note: Suggestions are PROPOSALS for review, not implemented changes. Status workflow: Proposed -> Under Review -> Accepted / Rejected / Deferred. No suggestion is implemented until the reviewer marks it Accepted in this file + COORDINATION.md. See docs/suggestions.html for decision criteria.

suggestions.title: Add licensed market-odds feed (closing lines) for CLV tracking
suggestions.rationale: Without closing lines, skill vs luck cannot be separated (no CLV). Unlocks edge measurement.
suggestions.risk: Cost/licensing; odds vary by book/time — must timestamp every snapshot.
suggestions.decision_needed: Approve vendor + budget; define which books count as 'closing'.

suggestions.title: Add play-by-play + snap-count data (nflverse / official)
suggestions.rationale: Enables EPA/success-rate team ratings and player-usage models; current totals-only model is too coarse.
suggestions.risk: Large data volume; need reproducible pipeline + versioning.
suggestions.decision_needed: Approve source (nflverse is free/public; verify terms) and storage.

suggestions.title: Automated daily injury/depth-chart refresh from NFL.com + team sites
suggestions.rationale: Manual snapshots go stale in hours (see F-02). Automation prevents decisions on outdated statuses.
suggestions.risk: Scraping fragility; must keep human verification step — never auto-publish unverified.
suggestions.decision_needed: Approve scheduler + alerting; confirm official sources list.

suggestions.title: Build Elo-style team ratings as model baseline (before any ML)
suggestions.rationale: Simple, auditable baseline beats opaque ML on small samples. Every fancier model must beat Elo out-of-sample.
suggestions.risk: Elo alone ignores injuries/matchups — must layer adjustments explicitly.
suggestions.decision_needed: Approve K-factor, home-field value, and margin-of-victory handling.

suggestions.title: Require 500+ graded bets + CLV gate before any strategy is 'live'
suggestions.rationale: Small samples are dominated by luck. Gates in strategies.html formalize this.
suggestions.risk: Slow to first 'live' strategy — by design.
suggestions.decision_needed: Confirm thresholds (n, ROI, CLV, log-loss) or adjust.

suggestions.title: Separate single-bet, parlay, and prop leaderboards (never mix ROI)
suggestions.rationale: Parlay ROI variance dwarfs singles; mixing hides skill/luck. Each market needs its own risk budget.
suggestions.risk: More tables to maintain — mitigated by shared grading code.
suggestions.decision_needed: Approve separate bankrolls / staking caps per market.

suggestions.title: Add weather + stadium data (roof/outdoor, wind, temp) from official sources
suggestions.rationale: Totals and passing props are weather-sensitive; outdoor late-season games need adjustment.
suggestions.risk: Forecast vs actual gap; must use forecast at bet time, not observed weather.

suggestions.title: Publish model cards (inputs, weights, calibration) for every line
suggestions.rationale: Decision-making requires knowing WHY a line moved. No black boxes.

suggestions.title: Add responsible-gambling guardrails (stake caps, loss limits, helpline)
suggestions.rationale: Project involves betting analysis; guardrails protect the operator and users.
suggestions.risk: None. Required before any real-money use.

suggestions.title: Freeze Week 11 lines as 'TBD' until QIA Q-01…Q-10 are answered
suggestions.rationale: Publishing uncalibrated lines as predictions would be hallucination. TBD is honest.
suggestions.risk: Site looks 'unfinished' — mitigated by clear explanation + working calculator.

suggestions.title: Add betting-splits / line-movement tracking (open vs close)
suggestions.rationale: Line movement reveals market information flow; helps distinguish sharp vs public signals.
suggestions.risk: Splits data licensing; definitions vary by source.

suggestions.title: Quarter-Kelly staking cap (max 1% per bet until 500 graded bets)
suggestions.rationale: Full Kelly on uncertain edges destroys bankrolls (see lines.html). Fractional Kelly is the evidence-based default.
suggestions.risk: Slower growth — acceptable vs ruin risk.
suggestions.decision_needed: Approve cap + review trigger at n=500.
